title: Label the first masjid
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y3 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: label the first masjid)
intro: Lesson 13: Building the first masjid in Madinah. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: The land
points: Land belonged to two orphan boys
The Prophet ﷺ paid for it
He did not just take it

panels.title: Everyone helped
points: The Prophet ﷺ carried bricks too

box.title: Draw the first masjid: walls, pillars and roof. Label each part and what it was made of.

keywords.def: the Prophet's ﷺ masjid in Madinah
to make something by putting parts together

questions.q: What was the masjid made from?
questions.a: Mud bricks, palm trunks and palm leaves

questions.q: Why did he pay for the land?
questions.a: To be fair to the orphan boys
options: To be fair to the orphan boys

questions.q: Name one use of the masjid apart from prayer.
Label a drawing of the first masjid: walls, pillars, roof, and what each was made of.
questions.a: Walls: mud brick; pillars: palm trunks; roof: palm leaves

questions.q: Extend: write two sentences on how everyone helped.
questions.a: Everyone carried bricks. The Prophet ﷺ carried bricks too.

questions.q: Stretch: why do you think the masjid came first?
questions.a: Prayer and worship of Allah are the centre of Muslim life.

questions.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ do while the masjid was built?
questions.a: A) Carried bricks with everyone. He worked beside the Companions: a leader who helps.

questions.q: Think again: why is the masjid the heart of a community?
questions.a: We pray, learn and help each other there.
